title: 句子升级
goal: 被动语态、to do 与 doing、定语从句入门、宾语从句、学期总复习

steps.title: 会议推迟了
lines: A
The meeting was postponed.
会议推迟了。
B
Really? When will it be held?
真的？什么时候开？
A
Next Monday. The new schedule has been sent to everyone.
下周一。新日程已经发给大家了。
steps.note: was postponed、will be held、has been sent：托业的通知、邮件里满是被动语态。

steps.title: 被动语态：be + 过去分词，什么时候用
what: 结构：be + 过去分词：English is spoken here.
主动 People speak English here. → 被动 English is spoken here.（宾语变主语）
什么时候用：① 不知道 / 不重要是谁做的（My bike was stolen.）② 想强调承受者（The meeting was postponed.）③ 正式文体、商务通知
需要说出做事的人时用 by：The book was written by a young doctor.
why: 英语喜欢把“话题”放在句首。通知里大家关心的是“会议”怎么样了，而不是“谁”推迟的，所以说 The meeting was postponed。
zh: 中文常用“被”表示不好的事（被偷、被骂），中性的事很少用“被”：“会议推迟了”“这座桥 1990 年建成”。英语这些都要用被动：The bridge was built in 1990.
反过来，中文“我出生在上海”没有“被”，英语却是被动：I was born in Shanghai.
ex: My bike was stolen last night.
我的自行车昨晚被偷了。
err: This car was made in Japan.
steps.sum: 被动 = be + 过去分词；不知道谁做 / 强调承受者 / 正式通知时用。

a: This bridge was built in 1990.
The bridge was built in 1990.

steps.title: 被动语态的时态：be 跟着变
what: 现在：is / are + done　过去：was / were + done
将来：will be + done　完成：has / have been + done
情态：can / must / should be + done　进行：is / are being + done
why: 被动的时态全靠 be 来表达，过去分词永远不变。先按主动句选时态，再把动词换成“be 的这个时态 + 过去分词”。
zh: 托业第 5 部分常考：The room hasn't been cleaned yet. / The report will be sent tomorrow. 中国学生常漏掉 been 或 be。
ex: The report will be sent tomorrow.
The room hasn't been cleaned yet.
err: The room hasn't been cleaned yet.

a: be
The meeting has been postponed until next Monday.
The meeting was postponed until next Monday.
The meeting has been postponed to next Monday.
The meeting was postponed to next Monday.

x: The table is made of wood.
桌子是木头做的。
I was born in 1995.
我出生于 1995 年。
This dish is called ramen.
这道菜叫拉面。

steps.text: The new schedule has been sent to everyone.
steps.zh: 新日程已经发给大家了。
steps.focus: has been 轻读，SENT 重读

points: 重点：被动 = be + 过去分词；不知道谁做、强调承受者、正式通知时用；I was born …。
重点：时态看 be —— is done / was done / will be done / has been done / must be done。
be made of 由……制成；be called 叫做。

steps.title: 期待你的回复
lines: Dear Ms. Lee,
李女士：
Thank you for coming to our office yesterday.
感谢您昨天来我们公司。
We decided to accept your proposal.
我们决定接受您的提案。
I look forward to hearing from you.
期待您的回复。
steps.note: decided to accept、thank you for coming、look forward to hearing：一封邮件里 to do 和 doing 都出现了。

steps.title: 意思不同的 to do / doing：stop、remember、try
what: stop doing 停止正在做的事 / stop to do 停下来去做另一件事
remember to do 记得要去做（还没做）/ remember doing 记得做过（已做）
forget to do 忘了去做 / forget doing 忘了做过
try to do 努力做 / try doing 试着做做看
why: 规律和上一学期学的一样：to do 指向“将来、还没做”，doing 指“已经在做 / 做过的事本身”。
zh: 中文“停下来抽烟”和“戒烟”完全不同，英语只差 to 和 -ing：stop to smoke / stop smoking。
err: Remember locking the door when you leave.
Remember to lock the door when you leave.
steps.sum: to do 还没做，doing 已经在做 / 做过。

drill.q: Please remember ___ the door when you leave.
He stopped ___ because he was tired.

steps.title: 介词后面用 doing：look forward to doing
what: 介词（for, of, in, at, about, without, before, after…）后面的动词用 -ing：Thank you for coming. I'm good at cooking. before leaving
这几个短语里的 to 是介词，后面也用 -ing：look forward to doing、be used to doing、object to doing
why: 介词后面要接名词，-ing 形式就是动词的“名词版”。look forward to 的 to 不是不定式标记，而是介词（look forward to the party 也成立），所以接 -ing。
zh: <s>I look forward to hear from you.</s> 是商务邮件里最常见的错误之一，托业也常考。
ex: I look forward to hearing from you.
err: I look forward to hear from you.
I look forward to hearing from you.
steps.sum: 介词 + -ing；look forward to / be used to 的 to 是介词。

drill.q: I look forward to ___ from you.

a: coming
I look forward to seeing you.
I'm looking forward to seeing you.
I am looking forward to seeing you.

s: 期待（to 是介词，接 doing）
x: I look forward to seeing you.
期待见到你。
I'm used to getting up early.
我习惯早起。
We decided to stay.
我们决定留下。

steps.text: I look forward to hearing from you.

steps.a: I look forward to seeing you.
I look forward to hearing from you.

steps.zh: 我们决定接受这个提案。
a: We decided to accept the proposal.
We've decided to accept the proposal.
We have decided to accept the proposal.

points: want / decide / plan / agree + to do；enjoy / finish / mind / avoid / keep + doing。
重点：stop / remember / forget / try + to do 和 doing 意思不同。
重点：介词后用 doing；look forward to doing、be used to doing。

steps.title: 帮过我的人
lines: A
Who is the woman who called you?
给你打电话的那位女士是谁？
B
She's the one who helped me find this job.
她就是帮我找到这份工作的人。
A
And the phone you bought last week?
你上周买的手机呢？
B
It's the best phone that I've ever had.
那是我用过最好的手机。
steps.note: the woman who called you、the phone you bought：英语用一个句子来修饰名词，放在名词后面。

steps.title: 定语从句：中文修饰在前，英语放在后
what: 中文：给你打电话的那位女士 —— 修饰语在名词前。
英语：the woman who called you —— 修饰的句子放在名词后，用关系词连接。
翻译时先说名词，再用 who / which / that 引出“的”字部分。
why: 英语修饰语短的放前面（a red car），长的放后面（a car that my father bought in 1990）。一整个句子做修饰语，就一定在后面。
zh: 中文“的”字结构可以很长很长地堆在名词前面；英语不行。写作时如果想说“我上周买的那部手机”，要先把名词说出来：the phone (that) I bought last week。
ex: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
住在隔壁的那个人是医生。
The bag which I bought yesterday is red.
我昨天买的包是红色的。
This is the best movie that I've ever seen.
这是我看过最好的电影。
err: The who lives next door man
The man who lives next door

drill.q: The woman ___ called you is my boss.
This is the phone ___ I bought last week.

drill.zh: 住在隔壁的那个人是医生。
a: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
The man that lives next door is a doctor.
The person who lives next door is a doctor.

steps.title: who / which / that / whose，什么时候能省
what: who 指人，which 指物，that 人和物都可以（口语最常用）
whose = ……的：the girl whose father is a pilot
where 指地点：the place where we met
关系词在从句里作宾语时可以省略：the movie (that) we saw；作主语时不能省：the man who lives here
why: 判断能不能省：看关系词后面是不是紧跟着一个新的主语。the movie we saw → 有新主语 we，that 是宾语，可省；the man lives here → 没有新主语，who 是主语，不能省。
zh: 中国学生容易漏写主语位置的关系词：<s>The man lives next door is a doctor.</s>（两个谓语撞在一起）
ex: The movie we saw was great.
我们看的电影很棒。（省略 that）
I know a girl whose father is a pilot.
我认识一个女孩，她爸爸是飞行员。
This is the café where we met.
这就是我们见面的咖啡馆。
err: The man lives next door is a doctor.
The man who lives next door is a doctor.
steps.sum: 后面有新主语 → 可省；没有 → 不能省。

drill.q: I know a boy ___ mother is a singer.
哪个句子可以省略关系词？
o: The man who called is here.
The movie that we saw was great.

drill.q: This is the place ___ we met.
a: where

x: She's the one who helped me.
她就是帮过我的那个人。
It's something that everyone needs.
这是每个人都需要的东西。
This is the place where we met.
这就是我们相遇的地方。

steps.text: She's the one who helped me find this job.
steps.zh: 她就是帮我找到这份工作的人。

steps.a: She is the one who helped me.
steps.zh: 她就是帮过我的那个人。

steps.a: She is the one who helped me.

a: This is the best book I've ever read.
This is the best book that I've ever read.
This is the best book I have ever read.
This is the best book that I have ever read.
It's the best book I've ever read.

points: 重点：中文修饰在前，英语定语从句在后：the woman who called you。
重点：who 人、which 物、that 都行、whose 的、where 地点；作宾语可省，作主语不能省。

steps.title: 问路要礼貌
lines: A
Excuse me, could you tell me where the station is?
打扰一下，能告诉我车站在哪儿吗？
B
Sure. I'm not sure if the bus is still running, though.
当然。不过我不确定公交还开不开。
A
I don't think it will rain, so I'll walk.
我觉得不会下雨，我走过去吧。
steps.note: where the station is、if the bus is running：问句放进另一个句子里，语序就变了。

steps.title: 间接疑问：问句放进句子里，用陈述语序
what: 直接问：Where is the station?
间接问：Could you tell me where the station is?（主语在前，动词在后）
一般疑问变间接：Is he coming? → I don't know if / whether he is coming.
do / does / did 要去掉：What does he want? → I'm not sure what he wants.
why: 被嵌进去的问句已经不是真正的问句了（整个句子才是问句），所以恢复正常语序。用间接问句更礼貌，托业的对话和邮件里大量出现。
zh: 中国学生常常照搬问句语序：<s>Do you know where is the station?</s>、<s>Can you tell me what time is it?</s>
ex: Do you know where the station is?
Could you tell me what time it is?
I wonder if she is angry.
我想知道她是不是生气了。
I'm not sure what he wants.
err: Do you know where is the station?
Do you know where the station is?
I'm not sure what does he want.
I'm not sure what he wants.
steps.sum: 嵌入的问句：疑问词 + 主语 + 动词；是否用 if / whether。

drill.q: Could you tell me what time ___?
I don't know ___ he will come or not.

a: Do you know where he lives?

steps.title: I don't think …：否定放在前面
what: 英语说“我认为……不……”时，习惯把否定放在 think 上：
I don't think it will rain.（比 I think it won't rain 自然得多）
同样：I don't believe …, I don't suppose …
why: 把否定提前，语气更委婉：先表明“我不这么认为”，再说内容。
zh: 中文“我觉得不会下雨”否定在后面，直译成 I think it won't rain 不算错，但听起来很生硬。
ex: I don't think it will rain.
— Is it far? — I don't think so.
err: I think he is not right.

o: I don't think it will rain.

drill.q: I wonder ___ she is angry. (为什么)
a: why
I don't think he will come today.
I don't think he'll come today.
I don't think he's coming today.

s: 我想知道是否……（委婉询问）
x: I wonder if you could help me.
不知你能否帮我。
I'm not sure what he means.
我不确定他是什么意思。
Could you tell me how to get there?
能告诉我怎么去吗？

steps.text: Could you tell me where the station is?
steps.zh: 能告诉我车站在哪儿吗？

steps.a: Could you tell me how to get there?
Could you tell me how to get there?

points: 宾语从句：I think (that) …；是否用 if / whether。
重点：间接疑问用陈述语序：Do you know where the station is?
重点：“我认为不……” → I don't think …
Could you tell me …? / I wonder if … 更礼貌。

steps.title: 一点点进步
lines: My English is getting better little by little.
我的英语一点点在进步。
I've finished the first semester.
我学完了第一学期。
Next, I'm going to prepare for the TOEIC test.
接下来，我要准备托业考试。
steps.note: 这一课把整个学期串起来：遇到一个句子，你应该知道先看什么、再看什么。

steps.title: 这一学期的语法地图
body: 句子 = 主语 + 谓语（+ 宾语/表语）；五种基本句型是一切句子的骨架。
名词：单复数、可数不可数；冠词 a/an/the；代词主格、宾格、物主、反身。
时态：一般现在、现在进行、一般过去、将来、现在完成；先找时间标志词。
修饰：形容词 vs 副词、比较级最高级、介词 in/on/at。
连接：and/but/so/because/although；定语从句 who/which/that；宾语从句陈述语序。
动词后接：情态动词 + 原形；被动 be + 过去分词；to do / doing 的固定搭配。
下一学期（托业 600）会把这些语法放进职场场景，练题型和速度。
ex: Although I started from zero, I have learned a lot this term.
虽然我从零开始，这学期学到了很多。

steps.title: 写一个句子之前，问自己四个问题
what: ① 谓语动词在哪？（没有动词不成句：I am busy）
② 时间是什么时候？（选时态：every day / now / yesterday / since / tomorrow）
③ 主语是单数还是复数？（三单 -s、is / are、was / were）
④ 主动还是被动？（东西不能自己做事：The email was sent）
why: 这四个问题对应了中国学生最常见的四类错误：缺动词、时态、主谓一致、主被动。写完一句话就过一遍，错误会少一大半。
zh: 中文不用考虑这四件事，所以写英语时它们最容易被漏掉。养成“写完检查四问”的习惯，比多背语法条目有用得多。
ex: My sister works in a bank.
我姐姐在银行工作。（三单）
I have already finished my homework.
我已经做完作业了。（完成时）
err: My sister work in a bank.
My sister works in a bank.
I have already finished my homework.
steps.sum: 动词、时间、主语、主被动 —— 写完一句检查四问。

x: Keep practicing every day.
每天坚持练习。
We'll do it step by step.
我们一步一步来。
My English is getting better little by little.
我的英语一点点在进步。

steps.text: My English is getting better little by little.
steps.zh: 我的英语一点点在进步。

steps.q: He is the ___ student in our class.

a: practicing
practising

steps.a: My English is getting better little by little.
steps.zh: 我的英语一点点在进步。

steps.a: My English is getting better little by little.

steps.prompt: 学期总结：用 6–8 句英语写一段“我的英语学习”。要求至少用到：现在完成时、一个被动句、一个定语从句、一个间接疑问（I'm not sure if … / I wonder …）、一个比较级。
steps.hint: 写完逐句用“四问”检查：动词、时间、主语、主被动。
steps.focus: present perfect, passive, relative clauses, indirect questions, comparatives
steps.model: I started learning English again three months ago. I have finished the first semester, and my grammar is much better than before. The mistakes that I made most often were about tenses and articles. Now I always check four things after I write a sentence. My pronunciation was checked by a teacher last month, and it is getting better little by little. I'm not sure if I can get 800 on the TOEIC next year, but I'm going to try my best.

points: 这一学期：句子骨架 → 名词冠词代词 → 现在、过去、将来 → 修饰连接 → 被动、非谓语、从句。
重点：写完一句话检查四问 —— 动词、时间、主语、主被动。
keep doing 坚持做；step by step 一步一步；little by little 一点一点。

steps.title: The Moon Bridge
steps.note: 先关掉译文读一遍，只用学过的词和本单元的重点。读不懂的句子点 ▶ 听一遍，再打开译文核对。
lines: In my hometown, there is an old stone bridge that was built about three hundred years ago.
我的家乡有一座古老的石桥，大约建于三百年前。
It is called the Moon Bridge because it looks like a half moon.
它叫月亮桥，因为样子像半个月亮。
The bridge is made of local stone, and it is still used by people every day.
桥是用本地的石头建的，至今每天还有人走。
Last year, the city decided to build a new road, and some people wanted to pull the old bridge down.
去年，市里决定修一条新路，有人想把老桥拆掉。
My grandfather, who was born near the bridge, was very sad.
在桥边出生的爷爷非常难过。
He remembered playing on it when he was a child.
他记得小时候在桥上玩。
He wrote a letter to the newspaper and asked, "Could you tell me why we have to lose our history?"
他给报社写了封信，问道：“能告诉我为什么我们非要失去自己的历史吗？”
His letter was read by thousands of people.
他的信被成千上万的人读到了。
Step by step, more and more people joined him, and in the end, the plan was changed.
慢慢地，越来越多的人支持他，最后计划被改了。
Now the new road goes around the bridge, and the place where my grandfather played is a small park.
现在新路绕桥而过，爷爷小时候玩耍的地方成了一座小公园。
I'm looking forward to walking across it with him this summer.
我很期待今年夏天和他一起走过这座桥。

steps.q: Why is the bridge called the Moon Bridge?
o: It looks like a half moon.
It is made of moon stone.

steps.q: What did the city want to do last year?

o: He wrote a letter to the newspaper.

steps.q: "My grandfather, ___ was born near the bridge, was very sad."

steps.zh: 这座桥是三百年前建的。
a: The bridge was built three hundred years ago.
This bridge was built three hundred years ago.
The bridge was built 300 years ago.

points: 重点：被动 —— was built / is called / is made of / is used / was read / was changed（be + 过去分词）。
重点：定语从句 —— a bridge that was built…、my grandfather, who was born…、the place where…。
to do / doing：decided to build、remembered playing（记得做过）、look forward to walking。
间接疑问：Could you tell me why we have to …?（问句放进句子里用陈述语序）

extra.q: The man ___ is talking to Mary is my uncle.
Can you tell me how much ___?
I don't know ___ she likes it.

a: getting

extra.a: This is the place where we met.
extra.zh: 这就是我们相遇的地方。

extra.a: We decided to stay at home.
